source_snapshot.procedure: Reuse verified mirror mapping; set both device masks0x3; inject/consume one UCE at0x100000000; inspect B2CMI status/address/misc and mirrorcorrerr/mccmdmirrregion/bankindex; go.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection succeeds and source B2CMI logs match.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic logs omit mirror correction and B2CMI fields.

old_problem: Full-Mirror address/B2CMI mapping, multi-device mask semantics, exact MCi_STATUS/MISC mirror fields and UCE recovery are platform-specific and unapproved.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires target authorization and Recovery. A UCE is materially different from row164 CE: PASS requires that Full Mirror correct the primary multi-device failure and that the intended B2CMI bank reports the approved address, mirrorcorrerr, mirrored-region and bank-index fields.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row165 and full history2549.
Preserved CE-recipe dependency, exact0x100000000/masks, one UCE, B2CMI raw/show fields and go.
Kept UCE mirror correction distinct from primary CE MSCOD and persistent failover cases.
No injection, go, clear or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GNR Full-Mirror primary UCE corrected through B2CMI
test_case.purpose: Prove one mapped primary-side multi-device UCE is corrected from the mirror and recorded by the intended B2CMI bank with correct attribution.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/FAE and CE-recipe dependency
Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB UCE recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies the inherited mirror topology/map, applies dev0/dev1 masks0x3, performs one UCE at0x100000000, captures target B2CMI status/address/misc raw and decoded mirrorcorrerr/mccmdmirrregion/bankindex, executes go once, verifies mirror/memory health and restores settings.
test_case.expected_result: The primary UCE is corrected through Full Mirror; intended B2CMI fields and mapped address/bank identity match, no fatal escape occurs, resume is healthy and settings are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact topology/address/mask identity, one UCE, correct B2CMI mirror-correction fields, healthy go and restoration. Wrong bank/side/severity, missing field, crash or degraded mirror fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT and explicit UCE authorization.
Do not inherit mapping unless the CE-recipe evidence matches this run.
Preserve baseline and clear only approved volatile target state.
One UCE/go only; no automatic retry or boot.
expected_evidence: Exact masks and single UCE transcript
test_case.recovery: On fatal escape, wrong B2CMI target or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery without reinjection; restore mirror/debug state and validate full memory topology.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and criteria consistently cover one primary UCE corrected by Full Mirror and reported by B2CMI.
